mustFix.problem: Photos render as empty frames in full-page captures (navy block with caption only; stone box with ruler only), in both motion and reduced-motion modes
mustFix.fix: Hero image loading=eager fetchpriority=high with no opacity/clip init state; plate 02 image visible by default, animate only transform, show immediately under prefers-reduced-motion; re-shoot and confirm both photos in 1440-full and 1440-rm-full

mustFix.problem: Day and time collide and wrap ('Mon7:30 am –' / '5 pm') in the two-column hours table
mustFix.fix: Below 560px use a single-column list; each row display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:1rem; day in a 3.5ch column; time white-space:nowrap

elevate.move: Make photography the test specimens: a tight material close-up per siding (lap vinyl, fiber-cement plank, cedar grain, engineered wood) carrying its five-cell reading and reveal measurement, replacing the two generic house shots as the report's plates

Wire the squares calculator into the price sheet: entered walls re-scale every price bar from per-sq-ft to the visitor's house total, animating bars and mono totals as the section enters, so the reading-fill motif pays off with their own number
